questions.stem: What effect does adding a catalyst have on the position of equilibrium?

options.text: It shifts the equilibrium to the right, producing more products
It shifts the equilibrium to the left, producing more reactants
It has no effect on the position of equilibrium, but equilibrium is reached faster
It depends on whether the catalyst is heterogeneous or homogeneous

questions.explanation: A catalyst speeds up both the forward and reverse reactions equally, so it does not change the position of equilibrium. The same ratio of products to reactants is achieved, but equilibrium is reached more quickly.
